name: print-social-three-type-experiment-posters-numbers-apple-pie-flight
title: Three type posters: scattered red zeros, apple halves under stacked words, and a rotated FLIGHT with pink rectangles
whatItIs: On black, three posters. One white with 'MORE NUMBERS' and a scatter of black and red zeros and a '2050' with red bars; one cream with 'TASTES LIKE SWEET APPLE PIE' in green and brown stacked around three halved apples; one white with a rotated black 'FLIGHT' and pink rectangles sliding diagonally.
whatItMeans: Playful and clever; each poster shows what its words say.
techniques: Scatter glyphs to illustrate the word.
Use tiny body columns as texture.

vocabulary.definition: Repeated characters spread as a pattern.
